biotools.summary: Apocryptovirus RdRp Assembler is a software resource used to assemble and analyze RNA viruses, specifically focusing on the identification and characterization of Apocryptoviruses within parasitic systems, as demonstrated by its use in the discovery of Apocryptovirus odysseus infecting Toxoplasma gondii.
